headline: Stock Market Rises More Than 1% on Oil Gains and Election Outlook; Dollar Falls - Bahia Notícias
summary: Brazil's stock market rose more than 1% on oil gains and expectations that Flávio Bolsonaro will lead Lula in this year's elections. The dollar fell.
why: The Bovespara index is Brazil's main equity benchmark and is sensitive to oil-linked shares and election polling.
why_moved: Oil gains and expectations that Flávio Bolsonaro will be ahead of Lula in the election favored Brazilian equities, while the dollar fell.
